[[Kana Hanazawa]] ([[JN060]])| }} '''Nurse Joy's Chansey''' (Japanese: '''ジョーイのラッキー''' ''Joy's Lucky'') are {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by almost all [[Nurse Joy]]s in the [[Kanto]], [[Johto]], [[Hoenn]], and [[Sinnoh]] [[region]]s, as well as the [[Orange Islands]]. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== {{incomplete|section|2=Clarification for locations each Chansey appeared in}} ====History==== [[File:Pokémon Center Chansey.png|thumb|left|220px|Chansey in her debut]] ====={{aniseries|OS}}===== ======[[Kanto]]====== Chansey first appeared in ''[[EP002|Pokémon Emergency!]]'', where two of them wheeled [[Ash's Pikachu]] into the [[Viridian City]] Pokémon Center's emergency room after he was injured badly from a flock of {{p|Spearow}} that {{Ash}} was protecting him from. In ''[[EP014|Electric Shock Showdown]]'', a Chansey from the [[Vermilion City]] Pokémon Center wheeled in a {{p|Pidgey}} after it lost a Gym battle against [[Lt. Surge]]. This caused Ash and Pikachu to worry about their upcoming Gym battle with Lt. Surge. In ''[[EP042|Showdown at Dark City]]'', a Nurse Joy sent out Chansey while revealing that she was undercover as an inspector for the [[Pokémon Inspection Agency]]. While Ash and {{ashfr}} were in [[Dr. Proctor]]'s hospital in ''[[EP047|A Chansey Operation]]'', Chansey wheeled in some injured Pokémon to Dr. Proctor's hospital as an extra room was needed since the Pokémon Center was full. Chansey then helped heal {{TRT}}'s Pokémon and {{MTR}}. When Team Rocket battled Ash and his friends, Chansey prevented them from doing so and as Chansey cared for {{TP|Jessie|Arbok}} and {{TP|James|Weezing}} earlier while they were injured, Arbok and Weezing refused to fight Chansey. After all the Pokémon were healed, Dr. Proctor and Chansey waved goodbye to Ash and his friends. ======[[Orange Islands]]====== In ''[[EP092|The Joy of Pokémon]]'', a Chansey traveled on a kayak with her Nurse Joy from island to island to treat injured Pokémon. In ''[[EP107|Pokémon Food Fight!]]'', a Chansey was seen with Nurse Joy while announcing the shipment of food delay to [[Butwal Island]]. ====={{aniseries|GS}}===== [[File:Matsuko Takeko and Umeko.png|thumb|220px|Matsuko, Takeko, and Umeko]] [[Jessie]] was revealed to have once befriended a Chansey, which she later met again in the [[Happy Town]] Pokémon Center in ''[[EP129|Ignorance is Blissey]]''. When she did, Chansey was revealed to have evolved into a {{TP|Nurse Joy|Blissey}}. In ''[[EP150|Hour of the Houndour]]'', a Chansey, along with Nurse Joy, bought groceries earlier and noticed an ice cream truck. They went to buy ice cream and then noticed their ham bag is empty. Later, Chansey took care of a wounded {{p|Houndour}}. The Nurse Joy of [[Lake Lucid]] has three Chansey that are [[nickname]]d (Japanese: '''マツコ''' ''Matsuko''), (Japanese: '''タケコ''' ''Takeko'') and (Japanese: '''ウメコ''' ''Umeko''), as seen in ''[[EP206|The Joy of Water Pokémon]]''. ====={{aniseries|AG}}===== ======[[Hoenn]]====== In ''[[AG008|A Tail with a Twist]]'', after {{AP|Treecko}} was beaten by a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}}, Chansey and Nurse Joy took care of Treecko. When Treecko disappeared from the Pokémon Center, Chansey ran off to warn Nurse Joy about the situation. In ''[[AG068|A Double Dilemma]]'', {{OBP|Rose|AG068}} delivered some groceries to the Pokémon Center and gave them to Chansey. During the delivery, she and Nurse Joy recognized that {{an|May}} and [[Max]] returned to [[North Petalburg]]. ======Kanto Battle Frontier====== In ''[[AG186|Overjoyed]]'', in an attempt for Ash to warm up for his rematch against [[Brandon]], Nurse Joy decided to battle Ash with her Chansey in May's place while Ash sent out his [[Ash's Corphish]]. As none of Corphish's attacks did any damage to Chansey, Chansey went on to defeat Corphish with {{m|Solar Beam}}. After the battle, Chansey and Nurse Joy took Corphish to heal up on a stretcher. When Team Rocket watched the battle, they were interested in Chansey because of the fact that she was strong. They did so by having {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} disguise himself as a Blissey. Team Rocket was able to grab Chansey but Chansey easily defeated Team Rocket. Afterwards, Chansey watched Ash's rematch against Brandon. The Chansey in [[Fennel Valley]] reappeared in ''[[AG188|Pinch Healing!]]'' where she witnessed Nurse Joy unconscious from a flu. She stayed by Nurse Joy's side as she lied down in bed until she felt better. ====={{aniseries|DP}}===== [[File:Nurse Joy and Chansey.png|thumb|250px|Nurse Joy and her Chansey]] In ''[[DP038|One Big Happiny Family!]]'', when Ash and his friends went to a Pokémon Center while on their way to [[Hearthome City]], a Chansey appeared and showed them where Nurse Joy was. Chansey then helped Nurse Joy with the hatching of [[Brock's Happiny]] {{pkmn|Egg}} in which they were successful. Chansey then partook in the battle against Team Rocket. One of them was used in battle under the ownership of a [[Pokémon Inspection Agency|PIA]] Nurse Joy in [[DPS02]]. She battled [[Brock's Sudowoodo]] at the [[Pewter Gym]]. Sudowoodo fell for Chansey's {{m|Attract}} and was defeated with an {{m|Egg Bomb}}; not laying a single hit. ====={{aniseries|BW}}===== Following Ash's arrival in [[Unova]], {{TP|Nurse Joy|Audino}} were featured instead of Chansey, as Chansey was not native to Unova. However, one would appear in [[BWS01]], as it took place in Johto. ====={{aniseries|JN}}===== In ''[[JN006|Working My Way Back to Mew!]]'', the Vermilion City Chansey tended to [[Goh's Scorbunny]]. In ''[[JN021|Caring for a Mystery!]]'', the Vermilion City Chansey monitored the {{pkmn|Egg}} that would ultimately hatch into [[Ash's Riolu]]. A Chansey appeared in [[Littleroot Town]] in ''[[JN022|Goodbye, Friend!]]''. ====Personality and characteristics==== Chansey is similar to her Trainer, Nurse Joy, as both are caring and nice to Trainers and Pokémon. Chansey usually assists Nurse Joy when a Trainer comes in and escorts the Pokémon on a stretcher. Despite being caring, Chansey is able to hold her own in battle, first evident in ''[[AG186|Overjoyed!]]'' where the one owned by the Nurse Joy was not only a good nurse, but a good battler as well. Chansey was able to defeat [[Ash's Corphish]] in an informal battle the two had as a result. During that battle, it was shown that Chansey, along with Nurse Joy, were more fierce towards opponents. After the battle, they revert back to their normal selves. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|normal||Nurse Joy Chansey {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=SolarBeam|1=Minimize|2=Attract|3=Pound|4=DynamicPunch}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Solar Beam|1=Minimize|2=Attract|3=Pound|4=Dynamic Punch}}|image2=Nurse Joy Chansey {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=DoubleSlap|1=Egg Bomb|2=Sing|3=Double-Edge}}.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Double Slap|1=Egg Bomb|2=Sing|3=Double-Edge}}}} {{anmov|normal|Double Slap|EP047|A Chansey Operation}} {{anmov|normal|Sing|EP129|Ignorance is Blissey}} {{anmov|fighting|Dynamic Punch|AG186|Overjoyed!}} {{anmov|normal|Double-Edge|AG186|Overjoyed!}} {{anmov|grass|Solar Beam|AG186|Overjoyed!}} {{anmov|normal|Egg Bomb|DP038|One Big Happiny Family!}} {{anmov|normal|Pound|DP131|Pedal to the Mettle!}} {{anmov|normal|Minimize|DPS02}} {{anmov|normal|Attract|DPS02}} {{anmov/f|normal}} ===''I Choose You!''=== [[File:Nurse Joy Chansey M20.png|thumb|250px|Chansey in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'']] Chansey is Nurse Joy's only known Pokémon. She helps her with nursing Pokémon at the [[Pokémon Center]]. Three different Chansey belonging to three different Nurse Joy appeared in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', a {{pkmn|movie}} set in an alternate continuity to {{aniseries|PTS}}. One appeared working alongside Nurse Joy in a Pokémon Center in a forest, where she helped taking care of an injured {{p|Vaporeon}}. Another belonging to a second Nurse Joy worked alongside her in a Pokémon Center in an unnamed town. She helped take care of [[Ash's Charmeleon]] after it got badly injured in a battle with [[Cross]]. A third worked with its Nurse Joy in a Pokémon Center near a lake, close to the [[Mt. Tensei|Raizen Mountains]]. It helped heal {{OBP|Ash's Pikachu|M20}} after he had battled with {{an|Ho-Oh}}. ===''Pokémon Horizons: The Series''=== [[Mollie]] bears some resemblance to a [[Nurse Joy]] or [[Pokémon Center lady]], particularly those in [[Alola]], and originally assisted in Pokémon Centers and trained to become a {{tc|doctor}}, before deciding she wanted to travel and help [[wild Pokémon]] in need. Like Nurse Joy, she owns a {{TP|Mollie|Chansey}}. A Nurse Joy's Chansey appeared in ''[[HZ003|For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!]]''. Another appeared in a fantasy in the same episode. An unnamed Pokémon Center lady with a Chansey appeared in ''[[HZ070|Tinkatink's Hammer Wasn't Made in a Day]]'', though she does not bear a close resemblance to Nurse Joy. ==In the games== ===In the core series=== [[File:Pokemon Center Yellow.png|200px|thumb|Chansey in Pokémon Yellow]] A Chansey can be seen beside Nurse Joy in every Pokémon Center in {{game|Yellow}} and [[Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!]], which are highly based on {{aniseries|OS}}. In {{game2|Diamond|Pearl|Platinum}}, a nurse named '''Casey''' (Japanese: '''メディ''' ''Medi'') participates in [[Rank (Contest)|Master Rank]] {{pkmn|Super Contest}}s with a {{p|Chansey}} [[nickname]]d '''Pinky''' (Japanese: '''ちゃんしー''' ''Chansey''). {{Pokémon/Contest | caption = '''{{3v2|Diamond|Pearl|Platinum}} - {{pkmn|Super Contest}}''' | gen = 4 | image = Spr 4d 113Pinky.png | size = 136px | ndex = 113 | pokemon = Chansey | nickname = Pinky | gender = female | type1 = Normal | move1 = Double-Edge | move1cat = Tough | move1app = 0 | move2 = Minimize | move2cat = Cute | move2app = 2 | move3 = Healing Wish | move3cat = Cute | move3app = 0 | move4 = Fling | move4cat = Tough | move4app = 1 }} ===Spin-off games=== ====[[Pokémon: Catch the Numbers!]]==== A Chansey appears in [[Pokémon: Catch the Numbers!]]. ====[[Pokémon Puzzle League]]==== A Chansey appeared in {{g|Puzzle League}}. ===Artwork=== {| style="margin:auto;
